Assets and licences

Every third-party file the site ships, or that the room bake uses, has a row here. Hand-made assets are listed too. The /credits page and the SaahilOS Credits app render this file.

The site is based on Henry Heffernan's portfolio (portfolio-website, MIT; portfolio-inner-site, used with his permission), heavily edited. Ideas from Alana Goyal's site (MIT). See NOTICE.

3D models

Desk, chair, computer, CRT, keyboard, mouse, cables, mug, papers, letter tray (environment.glb, computer_setup.glb, decor.glb) room desk group (desk_* in public/room/room.glb) https://github.com/henryjeff/portfolio-website/tree/b49482d6da1133cac0c7291a06dbedf89cb3a15f/static/models Henry Heffernan MIT geometry only: rescaled to metres (0.26 m per unit), every material rebuilt, relit and rebaked; his baked textures, backdrop, floor plant and binders not used
The room (v3, round seven): back, left and right-return walls, the ceiling band and cornice, the doorway, its door and the hallway beyond with its sconce, floor, the 1.5 x 1.44 m window and curtains, radiator, desk shelf, picture and shelf lights, desk lamp, two rugs and the hall runner, the projector's walnut wall shelf on brass brackets, CRT glass; the meshes hang under zone empties (zone_desk, zone_window, zone_kitchen, zone_reading, zone_wall_space, zone_photos, zone_records, zone_projector, zone_posters, zone_room) blender/room.blend, public/room/room.glb blender/scripts/build_room.py Saahil Sanganeriya (made for this site) CC0 1.0 —
Lava lamp (lava_lamp, lava_lamp_glass) the lamp alone on the credenza under the posters, lighting them blender/scripts/props_lava_lamp.py Saahil Sanganeriya (made for this site) CC0 1.0 unbranded
Lever espresso machine (espresso_machine, espresso_cup, espresso_coffee) the kitchen nook's counter; the demitasse and the coffee's surface are their own objects for the pour blender/scripts/props_espresso_machine.py Saahil Sanganeriya (made for this site) CC0 1.0 unbranded; decimated to 60 % in the room
Countertop oven (countertop_oven, oven_door, oven_glow, croissant) the kitchen nook's counter: a real cavity, a door that drops open on its bottom hinge (pivot on the hinge axis, 82 degrees about local +X) and a croissant on the rack, modelled as seven laminated rolls blender/scripts/props_countertop_oven.py Saahil Sanganeriya (made for this site) CC0 1.0 unbranded; dial words set in Blender's built-in font, Inter (SIL OFL 1.1)
The room's dressing: credenza, poster plaque, the mini kitchen (walnut counter, stone top, glazed tiles, open shelf with jars, cups and a row of spice jars, three mugs on brass hooks, a warm light bar under the shelf, chopping board, enamel pendant, a gooseneck kettle and an hourglass pour-over, a walnut board with two sesame bagels and two croissants, six cinnamon rolls cooling on a wire rack on the oven), photo album, projector dial, desk-shelf books, bookcase with its filler books and brass bookend, notebook, six sticky notes, headphones, jacket, pothos, floor books, a tall paper lantern on an oak tripod, a mug on the record cabinet blender/room.blend, public/room/room.glb blender/scripts/room_dressing.py Saahil Sanganeriya (made for this site) CC0 1.0 —
Instax board (photo_board, instax_slot_0..19) the left wall between the doorway and the roller screen: an oak-framed cork board with push pins, washi tape and a string of wooden clips (baked), and twenty Instax prints (Mini and Wide proportions at 1.2x, slight angles and overlaps), each its own quad with 0-1 UVs over the whole card and extras format, width_m, height_m, aspect, angle_deg, image_uv; a brass picture lamp over it blender/scripts/room_dressing.py Saahil Sanganeriya (made for this site) CC0 1.0 the stills show the collection's onWall photographs in its order; the site draws photo, card and caption
Pull-down roller screen (roller_screen_housing, roller_screen, projection_surface) the left wall above the kitchen's back end: a slim cream case on brass brackets (baked), the matte screen modelled fully down (extras drop_m 0.559, width_m 0.9) and the 16:9 picture on its face (0.90 x 0.506 m, 0-1 art UVs) blender/scripts/room_dressing.py Saahil Sanganeriya (made for this site) CC0 1.0 baked rolled up: the screen and the picture do not cast or catch the bake's light on other surfaces, and the projector's lamp is off in the bake; left out of the stills
Record corner (env_record_cabinet, record_player, platter, tonearm, record_crate, record_sleeve_0..5) the armchair corner, free-standing in front of the right return wall's end: a low walnut cabinet facing the chair, a walnut turntable with a black deck; the platter with its mat and a record turns about the spindle (pivot platter, turn_axis +Y, rpm 33.333); the tonearm swings about its base (pivot tonearm, turn_axis +Y, degrees counterclockwise seen from above: rest_angle_deg 0 on its rest, play_angle_deg -26.38 at the outer groove, end_angle_deg -50.31 at the inner groove); a pine crate of six LPs whose sleeve fronts are their own quads (0-1 UVs over the cover) blender/scripts/room_dressing.py Saahil Sanganeriya (made for this site) CC0 1.0 unbranded; the site draws the covers
The six books (book_spine_*): The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle, Kafka on the Shore, 1Q84 (Haruki Murakami), Kitchen (Banana Yoshimoto), On Earth We’re Briefly Gorgeous (Ocean Vuong), The Elegant Universe (Brian Greene) the bookcase in the reading corner: typographic spines and covers in the room's palette, baked blender/scripts/room_art.mjs (art), blender/scripts/room_dressing.py (books) Saahil Sanganeriya (made for this site) CC0 1.0 original designs: titles, authors and small line motifs only; no publisher's cover art, marks or text copied
Japanese-literature print (print_japanese_lit) leaning on the bookcase in a pale oak frame: a red sun, a second moon, "Murakami" blender/scripts/room_art.mjs Saahil Sanganeriya (made for this site) CC0 1.0 original typographic design
Georgia Tech pennant (pennant_gatech) pinned over the desk shelf blender/scripts/room_art.mjs, room_dressing.py Saahil Sanganeriya (made for this site) CC0 1.0 lettering in the school's colours (navy #003057, Tech Gold #B3A369); no logo or trademark device
Voyager Golden Record in a shadow box (voyager_record) the space wall over the bookcase: a gold disc engraved with the record cover's diagrams (record and stylus, playing time, picture construction, the pulsar map, hydrogen's two lowest states) and a plate, "The Sounds of Earth · Voyager Golden Record · 1977" blender/scripts/room_art.mjs (engraving), room_dressing.py; diagrams after https://science.nasa.gov/mission/voyager/golden-record-cover/ Saahil Sanganeriya (made for this site), after NASA/JPL's record cover CC0 1.0 (the cover's diagrams are NASA, public domain) the diagrams redrawn in simplified lines, not traced; the pulsar periods are not encoded
The window view: San Francisco and Delhi across one bay (Golden Gate Bridge, Sutro Tower, downtown with the Transamerica Pyramid and Salesforce Tower, Coit Tower, Alcatraz, the fog, the Painted Ladies; India Gate, Qutub Minar, the Lotus Temple, Humayun's Tomb, Jama Masjid, the Red Fort's wall, the Delhi Ridge), sky by day and night, haze with distance window_view_sf, window_view_delhi in public/room/room.glb; public/room/window_{sf,delhi}_{day,night}.ktx2; blender/renders/window_view.png blender/scripts/window_view.py Saahil Sanganeriya (made for this site) CC0 1.0 low-poly models of public landmarks, drawn from public photographs; no third-party model or image used; placed behind the bigger window at 1.45 times its round-two size
Potted Plant 02 (potted_plant_02) the syngonium on the floor by the window https://polyhaven.com/a/potted_plant_02 Rico Cilliers (Poly Haven) CC0 1.0 1K textures; decimated from 69.8k to 2.4k triangles, scaled to 62 cm; baked
Potted Plant 04 (potted_plant_04) the haworthia on the window sill https://polyhaven.com/a/potted_plant_04 James Ray Cock (Poly Haven) CC0 1.0 1K textures; decimated from 6.1k to about 2k triangles, scaled to 17 cm; baked
